Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained] condition.

Bounding jumps and whirls spin you out of control and set aside all restraints. Attempt to Escape. If you succeed, you can immediately Step as a free action and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your DCs to avoid being grabbed or restrained until the start of your next turn.
